summary: Build audit dashboards, DAX measures, and exception analysis skills in five practical Power BI training days. View the course outline and enrol.
lede: Power BI audit visualization helps audit professionals turn operational data into reviewable findings and management-ready reports. Designed for audit practitioners working with evidence, risk data, controls, or compliance reporting, it develops skills to prepare and reconcile data, test controls, analyze exceptions, and build dashboards that explain risk significance.
audienceIntro: Power BI for Audit Visualization Training suits professionals who already work with audit evidence, risk data, controls, or compliance reporting and need stronger analytical and visual reporting capability. This course is designed for audit practitioners who need to convert operational data into reviewable findings and management-ready dashboards.
modules: Power BI Service Governance for Audit
prerequisites: You should have practical exposure to internal audit, IT audit, compliance testing, risk assurance, financial controls, or audit reporting. Basic familiarity with Excel tables, audit populations, control objectives, and filtering data will help. No programming experience is required, but you should be comfortable working with structured data and reviewing evidence. The course treats advanced DAX, AI-assisted anomaly analysis, Power BI Service governance, and automated refresh as operational application topics, not production engineering. Bring a laptop with Power BI Desktop access if your delivery arrangement supports it.
